demos.question: How many products are discontinued? Return an integer.
demos.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Products WHERE Discontinued='1'

demos.question: Top 3 categories by total quantity sold in 2019, highest first. Return list[{category:str, quantity:int}].
demos.sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, SUM(od.Quantity) q FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID=p.CategoryID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31' GROUP BY c.CategoryID ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 3
